basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The EE department of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is inviting applications for one temporary Project Engineer (Photonics Device Design and Development) position under the SAMARTH project, with consolidated remuneration of INR 60,000 – 1,25,000 per month including HRA, for one year initially. The essential qualification is a Ph.D. or equivalent in an appropriate discipline, or M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent with at least 2 years of post-qualification experience. Applications go through http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ and the last date is 5 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Gandhinagar
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Research & Development Office of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar, a technical institute in Gandhinagar. The post sits in the EE department and serves the project Silicon and Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing Research and Training Hub (SAMARTH). The notice calls the position temporary.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice ticks Institute norms for eligibility; the Funding Agency norms box is not ticked. The essential qualification has two alternatives: Ph.D. or equivalent in an appropriate discipline with a very good academic record throughout; OR M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent in an appropriate discipline with at least 2 years of post-qualification experience in teaching, research, industry or design in an organization of repute. For both alternatives, the notice requires a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in Class 10 and Class 12. Thin-Film Deposition: hands-on experience with sputtering, electron-beam evaporation, CVD and ALD. Lithography and Nanofabrication: experience with electron-beam lithography, photolithography, etching and fabrication of micro/nanostructures. Material Characterization: experience with SEM, AFM, profilometry and thin-film characterization techniques. Optical Characterization: experience with spectrometry, T/R measurements, lasers/detectors, optical benchtop setups. Electromagnetic Simulation: familiarity with optical metasurface design and simulation using Lumerical, COMSOL or equivalent tools. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Project Engineer will lead the design, simulation, fabrication and optical characterization of optical metasurfaces, in addition to supporting training activities of the SAMARTH program and nanofabrication center. Key responsibilities: Metasurface Design & Simulation: designing and optimizing optical nanostructures using Lumerical, COMSOL or equivalent tools. Nanofabrication: developing fabrication workflows involving electron-beam lithography, photolithography, thin-film deposition and etching. Material Characterization: characterizing fabricated structures using SEM, AFM and other microscopy techniques. Optical Characterization: performing reflectance, transmittance, spectroscopy and polarization-dependent measurements. Experimental Development: correlating measurements with simulations and optimizing metasurface designs and fabrication processes. Training and Lab Support: supporting SAMARTH center training programs and the operation of the Computational photonics lab.
